Lemma
[Local smooth extension]

If $f$ is smooth on an open $U\subset M$ and $q\in U$, then some smooth $f'\colon M\to \Ar $ agrees with $f$ near $q$.
Proof

\sketch

Multiply $f$ by a bump function supported in $U$ and equal to $1$ near $q$, then extend by zero.

□
